title: Vicky the Friendly Vampire
description: Vicky, a tiny cute vampire, makes new friends in the night park and shares funny spooky adventures with them.

scenes.description: wide shot of children playing in night park under soft moonlight
scenes.visual_prompt: (wide shot:1.2) children playing happily in night park, soft moonlight, trees and benches, storybook style:1.3
scenes.narration: आरव और मीरा रात के पार्क में खेल रहे थे, जब उन्होंने कुछ अजीब देखा।
scenes.subtitle: Night Playtime

scenes.description: close-up of small cute vampire hiding behind tree with playful eyes
scenes.visual_prompt: (close-up:1.2) small cute vampire hiding behind tree, playful eyes, night, storybook style:1.3
scenes.narration: पड़ोसी पेड़ के पीछे एक छोटा प्यारा वैम्पायर छिपा था।
scenes.subtitle: The Hidden Vampire

scenes.description: medium shot of children approaching vampire cautiously with smiles
scenes.visual_prompt: (medium shot:1.2) two children cautiously approaching small vampire, friendly smiles, night park background, storybook style:1.3
scenes.narration: आरव और मीरा धीरे-धीरे वैम्पायर के पास गए, डर के बजाय दोस्ती दिखाते हुए।
scenes.subtitle: Making Friends

scenes.description: close-up of vampire showing funny little fangs and silly smile
scenes.visual_prompt: (close-up:1.2) small vampire showing tiny funny fangs and silly smile, night, storybook style:1.3
scenes.narration: विक्की ने अपनी छोटी-छोटी दांतें दिखाई और सबको हँसाया।
scenes.subtitle: Funny Fangs

scenes.description: wide shot of all three laughing and playing hide and seek in park
scenes.visual_prompt: (wide shot:1.2) children and small vampire laughing, playing hide and seek in night park, storybook style:1.3
scenes.narration: तीनों ने मिलकर छुपन-छुपाई खेली और रात को मज़ेदार बना दिया।
scenes.subtitle: Hide and Seek Fun

scenes.description: medium shot of vampire waving goodbye under glowing moon
scenes.visual_prompt: (medium shot:1.2) small vampire waving goodbye under glowing full moon, night park, storybook style:1.3
scenes.narration: रात खत्म हुई और विक्की ने चाँद के नीचे हाथ हिलाकर विदा ली।
scenes.subtitle: Goodnight Vicky
